# AR Webcrafts LLC

> AR Webcrafts LLC is a premier digital engineering and software development agency specializing in enterprise WordPress plugin development, custom SaaS platforms, bespoke softwares, white label partnerships, and dedicated development resources.

## Core Capabilities & Services

- **WordPress Plugin Development**: Custom WordPress plugins built from scratch for commercial sale, SaaS platforms, or proprietary business automation. Shipped 30+ commercial plugins including WebinarIgnition, CF7 WOW Styler, and 5 Stars Rating Funnel.
- **Custom Softwares & Web Applications**: Bespoke software architecture, enterprise web apps, high-volume transactional portals, and custom WooCommerce ecosystems.
- **SaaS Architecture & Engineering**: Multi-tenant SaaS products, subscription management, payment processing (Stripe, PayPal), and scalable cloud infrastructure.
- **White Label Partnership**: Serving digital agencies across the US, UK, Europe, and Australia as their behind-the-scenes engineering force with NDA protection and fixed-price guarantees.
- **Dedicated Development Resources / Developer**: Elite full-stack WordPress and PHP/React developers assigned on dedicated monthly basis with 24/7 technical support.
